definitions.explanation: Dark reddish-brown miso fermented for a longer period (often a year or more). Saltier and stronger in flavor than {白味噌|しろみそ}. Associated with the Tōhoku and Aichi regions; Nagoya's {八丁|はっちょう}{味噌|みそ} is a famous variety.

examples.japanese: {赤味噌|あかみそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make miso soup with red miso.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}み→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{赤味噌|あかみそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Nagoya's miso-stewed udon uses red miso.

examples.japanese: {赤味噌|あかみそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Red miso has a strong saltiness, so it's better to adjust the amount.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (red) + ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso). The color comes from the Maillard reaction during long fermentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤味噌|あかみそ}{仕立|じた}て: prepared with red miso
- {赤味噌|あかみそ}{文化圏|ぶんかけん}: red-miso cultural region (esp. Aichi)
- ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{赤味噌|あかみそ}: Nagoya red miso
- {赤味噌|あかみそ}⟦{煮込|にこ}み→煮込み：19761_nikomi⟧: red-miso stew

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白味噌|しろみそ}→白味噌：28917_shiromiso⟧: white miso — lighter, sweeter, shorter fermentation
- ⟦{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}→合わせ味噌：28934_awasemiso⟧: blended miso — mix of red and white
- {八丁|はっちょう}⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: Hatchō miso — famous Nagoya variety of red miso
